name: Jito

requiredConfig.name: @solana/spl-stake-pool
requiredConfig.description: Optional MCP server dependency required for Jito stake-pool reads, stake SOL, unstake JitoSOL, and inactive stake-account SOL withdrawal.

requiredConfig.name: @jito-foundation/stake-deposit-interceptor-sdk
requiredConfig.description: Optional MCP server dependency required for depositing an existing stake account into Jito through the interceptor, reading interceptor receipts, and claiming receipt JitoSOL.

requiredConfig.name: @solana/spl-token
requiredConfig.description: MCP server dependency used to create or find the JitoSOL associated token account when claiming an interceptor receipt.

requiredConfig.name: JITO_CONNECTOR_ENABLED
requiredConfig.description: Set to false to force-disable Jito readiness. Undefined or any other value uses installed SDK readiness.

readCapabilities.returns: JitoSOL mint, stake pool address, exchange rates, total lamports, pool token supply, fees, and optional validator list.
Wallet JitoSOL token balance and optional stake accounts with Jito deposit eligibility.
Stake accounts controlled by the wallet, including withdraw authority, validator vote account, lockup, deactivation state, and Jito deposit eligibility.
Read-only quote for stake SOL, deposit stake account, unstake JitoSOL, or withdraw SOL from a deactivated stake account.
Wallet Jito stake-deposit interceptor receipts, or a specific receipt account, including owner, JitoSOL amount, cooldown, claimable time, and early-claim fee basis points.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that captures SOL amount, quote, exchange rate, and optional minimum JitoSOL output.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Jito stake-pool deposit SOL transaction rebuilt at execution time.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that validates an existing delegated stake account and records the expected claimable JitoSOL output.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Jito stake-deposit interceptor transaction that creates a deposit receipt; JitoSOL may be claimable after cooldown rather than immediately delivered.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that captures JitoSOL amount, withdraw mode, quote, and optional minimum SOL output.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Jito stake-pool withdrawal rebuilt at execution time, either to a stake account or reserve SOL when available.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction for withdrawing SOL from an inactive or deactivated stake account.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A native stake-program withdraw instruction. Execution refuses stake accounts that are still active.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that validates receipt ownership and cooldown status before claiming JitoSOL from a Jito stake-deposit interceptor receipt.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Jito stake-deposit interceptor claim transaction. The connector refuses cooldown-period claims unless allowEarlyClaim is explicitly true.

requiredUserInputs.name: stakeAccount
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which stake account should Jito use?

requiredUserInputs.name: jitoSolAmount
requiredUserInputs.prompt: How much JitoSOL do you want to unstake?

requiredUserInputs.name: withdrawMode
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Should unstaking return a stake account or reserve SOL when available?

requiredUserInputs.name: receiptAddress
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Jito deposit receipt should be claimed?

requiredUserInputs.prompt: Allow claiming before cooldown completion and accept any interceptor early-claim fee?

requiredConnectorFacts: Current Jito stake pool exchange rate
Current deposit and withdrawal fee schedule
Connected wallet JitoSOL balance for unstake
Stake account withdraw authority and validator vote account for stake-account deposit
Stake account activation/deactivation state before SOL withdrawal
Deposit receipt owner, cooldown completion, claimable time, and early-claim fee before receipt claim
Min-output guard result immediately before wallet approval when a minimum is supplied
unsupportedRequests: Restake JitoSOL or interact with restaking protocols through Jito.
Manage Jito validator set, stake-pool governance, or authorities.
Trade, stake, vote, or govern with JTO.
Deposit an existing stake account without the Jito stake-deposit interceptor SDK installed.
Operate on any cluster other than mainnet-beta.
actionPreparationNotes: Use the official JitoSOL mint J1toso1uCk3RLmjorhTtrVwY9HJ7X8V9yYac6Y7kGCPn and stake pool Jito4APyf642JPZPx3hGc6WWJ8zPKtRbRs4P815Awbb. Stake and unstake paths use @solana/spl-stake-pool. Existing stake-account deposits and receipt claims use @jito-foundation/stake-deposit-interceptor-sdk; deposits derive the receipt and claims create the wallet JitoSOL ATA idempotently when needed. Minimum output is rechecked immediately before the wallet prompt as an execution-time off-chain guard.
riskNotes: JitoSOL exchange rate, fees, reserve SOL availability, and stake activation state can change before approval. Existing stake-account deposits may create a claimable receipt rather than immediately delivering JitoSOL. Receipt claims during cooldown can pay an interceptor fee and require explicit allowEarlyClaim. Unstaking to a stake account may require stake deactivation before SOL can be withdrawn.
walletApprovalBoundary: Reads return facts without wallet involvement. Stake, deposit-stake-account, receipt claim, unstake, and stake-account SOL withdrawal actions rebuild a transaction at execute time that the wallet must sign and broadcast. The agent never signs.

requests.agentResponse: Read the wallet JitoSOL balance and token accounts without signing.
